en: \bWould you like to see some of the fossils we've revived?

id: \bI wish I had a fossil. They are so rare and cool.
en: \bI wish I had a fossil. They are so rare and cool.

it: \bPassiamo un sacco di tempo a cercare di riportare in vita i fossili.  Pedro ci dà una grossa mano.

id: \bHi... Sorry, I'm not in the mood to revive any fossils. Ever since Byron left I haven't had the energy.
en: \bHi... Sorry, I'm not in the mood to revive any fossils.  Ever since Byron left I haven't had the energy.
it: \bCiao... Scusa, non me la sento di rigenerare fossili.  Da quando Ferruccio se n'è andato non ho più energie.
